question: 对比一下各个渠道
content: SELECT p.category AS 商品类别, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 销量, SUM(f.order_amount) AS GMV, AVG(f.order_amount) AS AOV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 销量 DESC;

question: 浙江省1月的销售额是多少？

question: 哪些品牌的销售额低于5000元？
content:
SELECT p.brand, SUM(o.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
HAVING SUM(o.order_amount) < 5000;

question: 1月每天的销售额分别是多少？
content: SELECT d.day AS day, SUM(f.order_amount) AS sales_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.month = 1 GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day;

question: 3月卖得最好的商品是什么？
content:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.order_amount) AS gmv
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(DATE(o.date_id), '%Y-%m') = '2025-03'
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 1;
